Overview

Got an idea? Come build it — in person, with a room full of makers. AI Vibe Sprint Jakarta is a hands on building session where you go from idea to working product in a single session. No prior tech experience needed. Just bring a laptop and curiosity.

What's Happening?

  • Vibe Building Session: Open floor to build with Emergent. Free credits provided on the spot. Mentors and builders are in the room if you get stuck.

  • Showcase + Workshop (20 mins): Live demos from fellow builders and see what's possible when you go from idea to app in minutes.

  • Team Building & Networking: Form teams on the spot. Meet PMs, founders, designers, and developers in a casual and high energy setting.

  • Food & Drinks: On the house.

Why Join?

  • Ship a working product in a single session.
  • Free Emergent credits to go from idea to app in minutes.
  • Meet builders and makers from Jakarta.
  • Walk out with something you actually built.

This is not a conference. Not a pitch night. It's a room full of laptops open and ideas shipping.

What to Bring

  • A charged laptop
  • An idea
  • Curiosity and willingness to build
  • No coding skills required

About The Product Folks

The Product Folks is one of the world's largest volunteer driven communities of product builders, leaders, and founders who want to shape the future and grow together. They host events, mixers, dinners, and community experiences across 30+ cities globally.

Spaces are limited and filling up quickly.

Eligibility

All participants are eligible to register for AI Vibe Sprint Jakarta

Rules

  • Fresh Builds Only
    All projects, prototypes, and code must be built during the 4 hour sprint. Pre existing projects are not allowed, but using open source templates or boilerplates is completely fine.

  • Leverage AI
    Your project must actively use AI features, APIs, or AI assisted development tools such as Emergent, Cursor, Bolt, or Replit.

  • Team Size
    Participants can join individually or in teams of up to 4 members. Teams can be formed before or during the event.

  • Offline Participation Only
    This is a fully offline event. Participants must be physically present at the Gurgaon venue to build, showcase, and qualify for recognition.

  • Submission Deadline
    Final project submissions must be completed before the sprint ends. Late submissions will not be considered.

  • Respect & Fair Play
    Keep the environment collaborative, inclusive, and respectful. Plagiarism, harmful behavior, or misuse of tools will not be tolerated.
